items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Joe Glaser's management of Louis Armstrong ('He bought Louie from a guy... he sold Louie to Joe Glaser'), but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship between himself (Barney Bigard) and Glaser.

ctx.x: -- Red Callender and Beal, [Charlie D.] [Eddie] Beal.
